segments.text: I'm 30, but my skin age is 21, and I reversed it very scientifically. [music] I'm going to tell you everything I've done, as well as how you can do this, too. Now, before we get in, there are many [music] ways to measure skin age, and the device that I'm using measures eight very critical skin age markers, things like UV, brown spots, [music] red spots. So, this does not measure everything about the skin. So, of course, I don't look 21 years old. There are many things that make up skin aging, for example, bone loss, collagen loss, hydration, that this device doesn't measure. But, in these eight key areas, my skin age is 21, [music] which goes to show that you can
meaningfully reverse skin age, and not just put it on pause.
